title: Longest Balanced Subarray I
summary: Given an integer array, find the length of the longest subarray where the count of distinct even numbers matches the count of distinct odd numbers.
statement: Given an integer array, find the length of the longest subarray where the count of distinct even numbers matches the count of distinct odd numbers.
constraints: nums contains one to 1,500 positive integers.
Balance compares counts of distinct even and distinct odd values, not occurrence counts.
Return the longest contiguous balanced subarray length.
hints: Only the first occurrence of each value inside a candidate window changes its parity counts.
Fix each left endpoint, extend right, and maintain a set plus distinct even/odd counters.
Update a counter only for a newly seen value and record the length whenever the counters match.
Every subarray is visited once by its endpoints and the maintained counters exactly describe its two distinct-value sets.
editorial: Every subarray is visited once by its endpoints and the maintained counters exactly describe its two distinct-value sets.

tests.explanation: Two distinct even and two distinct odd values make the full length four balanced.
The full array has two distinct values of each parity, so its length is five.
